scenes.name: WILLIAM THE CONQUEROR — The Machine
scenes.script:
# ============ WILLIAM THE CONQUEROR — THE MACHINE — Georgist economy ============
# Every c_* coefficient is a worldState variable: tune live.

# --- Drama panel: readouts + the lever; levers move via ORDERS ---
[SLIDER singleTax at 90,82 min=0 max=1 step=1 label="SINGLE TAX"]

[GAUGE wages at 8,12 min=0 max=60 label="WAGES"]
[GAUGE rent at 8,34 min=0 max=40 label="RENT"]
[GAUGE marginHeight at 8,56 min=0 max=100 label="MARGIN"]
[GAUGE hoard at 8,78 min=0 max=600 label="HOARD"]

# --- The rig: transforms driven by the economy ---
[BIND production_wheel.rotation to wheelAngle]
[BIND rent_siphon.rotation to clamp(rent * 2, 0, 75)]
[BIND speculation_brake.y to 30 + speculation * 0.12]
[BIND wage_pipe.scale to clamp(wages / 30, 0.3, 2.5)]
[BIND interest_pipe.scale to clamp(interest / 10, 0.3, 2.5)]
[BIND margin_floor.y to 78 - marginHeight * 0.14]
[BIND hoard_reservoir.scale to clamp(0.6 + hoard / 300, 0.6, 3)]
[BIND prestige_shell.opacity to 0.25 + prestige / 130]
[BIND prestige_shell.scale to 0.8 + prestige / 120]

[BUTTON tune_button]
[BUTTON menu_button]
# orders are for commanders, not spectators
[IF autopilot == 0]
[BUTTON ch1_orders_button]
[ENDIF]


[TICK 500ms]
# progress raises productivity; education accelerates it
[SET productivity = clamp(productivity + c_prodGrowth * (1 + education / 200), 0.5, c_prodMax)]

# speculation and greed LOWER the margin; regulation and the single tax raise it
[SET marginHeight = clamp(100 - speculation * c_specMargin - greed * c_greedMargin + regulation * c_regMargin + singleTax * c_taxMargin, 5, 100)]

# product of labor (wages' true source — anti-wage-fund)
[SET product = laborForce * productivity * (marginHeight / 100)]

# rent captures the gap between best land and the margin
[SET rent = product * (1 - marginHeight / 100) * (greed / c_rentGreedDiv)]
[IF singleTax == 1]
[SET publicFund = publicFund + rent * c_taxRedirect]
[SET rent = rent * (1 - c_taxRedirect)]
[ENDIF]

# wages and interest move together, squeezed by rent
[SET wages = max(product - rent, c_survivalFloor)]
[SET interest = wages * c_interestShare]

# hoard and prestige
[SET hoard = max(hoard + rent - repression * c_repressionCost - c_prestigeSpend, 0)]
[SET prestige = clamp(prestige + c_prestigeSpend - education * c_eduPrestige, 0, 100)]

# flare-ups: poverty past threshold; hierarchy raises tolerance, education lowers it
[SET flareThreshold = c_flareBase + hierarchy * c_flareHier - education * c_flareEdu]
[SET flareUps = clamp(floor((flareThreshold - wages) / c_flareDiv), 0, 6)]

# crisis: speculative prices outrun production
[SET crisisRoll = rand()]
[IF speculation > c_crisisSpecMin]
[IF crisisRoll < c_crisisChance]
[SET crisis = 1]
[SET product = product * 0.5]
[ENDIF]
[ENDIF]
[IF speculation <= c_crisisSpecMin]
[SET crisis = 0]
[ENDIF]

# single tax feedback: the fund raises the margin and education
[IF singleTax == 1]
[SET marginHeight = clamp(marginHeight + publicFund * c_fundMargin, 5, 100)]
[SET education = clamp(education + publicFund * c_fundEdu, 0, 100)]
[ENDIF]

# spin the wheel at product speed
[SET wheelAngle = wheelAngle + product * c_wheelSpeed]

# autopilot: the billionaire runs the machine
[IF autopilot == 1]
[SET greed = clamp(greed + c_autoDrift * (rand() - 0.35), 0, 100)]
[SET speculation = clamp(speculation + c_autoDrift * (rand() - 0.4), 0, 100)]
[IF flareUps >= 3]
[SET repression = clamp(repression + c_autoDrift, 0, 100)]
[ENDIF]
[ENDIF]

# flare-up visuals: distress sparks, deep distress burns
[IF flareUps >= 1]
[EFFECT electric_flare on human_1]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 1]
[CLEAR_EFFECT electric_flare from human_1]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 3]
[EFFECT flame_burn on human_1]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 3]
[CLEAR_EFFECT flame_burn from human_1]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 2]
[EFFECT electric_flare on human_2]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 2]
[CLEAR_EFFECT electric_flare from human_2]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 4]
[EFFECT flame_burn on human_2]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 4]
[CLEAR_EFFECT flame_burn from human_2]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 3]
[EFFECT electric_flare on human_3]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 3]
[CLEAR_EFFECT electric_flare from human_3]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 5]
[EFFECT flame_burn on human_3]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 5]
[CLEAR_EFFECT flame_burn from human_3]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 4]
[EFFECT electric_flare on human_4]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 4]
[CLEAR_EFFECT electric_flare from human_4]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 6]
[EFFECT flame_burn on human_4]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 6]
[CLEAR_EFFECT flame_burn from human_4]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 5]
[EFFECT electric_flare on human_5]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 5]
[CLEAR_EFFECT electric_flare from human_5]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 7]
[EFFECT flame_burn on human_5]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 7]
[CLEAR_EFFECT flame_burn from human_5]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 6]
[EFFECT electric_flare on human_6]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 6]
[CLEAR_EFFECT electric_flare from human_6]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 8]
[EFFECT flame_burn on human_6]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 8]
[CLEAR_EFFECT flame_burn from human_6]
[ENDIF]

# the billionaire basks while the hoard grows
[IF hoard > 100]
[EFFECT gold_glow on billionaire]
[ENDIF]
[IF hoard <= 100]
[CLEAR_EFFECT gold_glow from billionaire]
[ENDIF]

# crisis shakes the wheel; a vast hoard glows
[IF crisis == 1]
[EFFECT shake_all on production_wheel]
[ENDIF]
[IF crisis == 0]
[CLEAR_EFFECT shake_all from production_wheel]
[ENDIF]
[IF hoard > 300]
[EFFECT gold_glow on hoard_reservoir]
[ENDIF]
[IF hoard <= 300]
[CLEAR_EFFECT gold_glow from hoard_reservoir]
[ENDIF]

# news ticker: the most dramatic true headline wins
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "THE DAILY LEDGER — PRODUCT {product} · WAGES {wages} · RENT {rent}"]
[IF hoard > 300]
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "FORTUNE OF {hoard} — SOCIETY PAGES SWOON — WAGES {wages}"]
[ENDIF]
[IF wages <= c_survivalFloor + 2]
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "WAGES AT SURVIVAL — {wages} — BREADLINES LENGTHEN"]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 2]
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "UNREST REPORTED — {flareUps} DISTRICTS RESTIVE — WAGES {wages}"]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 4]
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "UPRISINGS SPREAD — {flareUps} DISTRICTS BURNING"]
[ENDIF]
[IF singleTax == 1]
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "SINGLE TAX IN EFFECT — PUBLIC FUND AT {publicFund} — MARGIN {marginHeight}"]
[ENDIF]
[IF crisis == 1]
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "PANIC! SPECULATION OUTRUNS PRODUCTION — MARKETS SEIZE"]
[ENDIF]

# Narraton commentary cadence
[SET commentaryTimer = commentaryTimer + 1]
[SET narratonGo = 0]
[IF commentaryTimer > c_commentaryCooldown]
[IF crisis == 1]
[SET narratonGo = 1]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= c_commentaryFlareMin]
[SET narratonGo = 1]
[ENDIF]
[IF singleTax == 1]
[IF publicFund > 40]
[SET narratonGo = 1]
[ENDIF]
[ENDIF]
[ENDIF]
[IF narratonGo == 1]
[SET commentaryTimer = 0]
[NARRATON pool=ch1]
[ENDIF]

# COLLAPSE: wages pinned at survival with mass flare-ups, sustained
[IF wages <= c_survivalFloor + 1]
[IF flareUps >= 5]
[SET collapseTimer = collapseTimer + 1]
[ENDIF]
[ENDIF]
[IF wages > c_survivalFloor + 1]
[SET collapseTimer = 0]
[ENDIF]
[IF collapseTimer > c_collapseTicks]
[SCENE ending_collapse]
[ENDIF]

# RECONSTITUTION: single tax held while education climbs, sustained
[IF singleTax == 1]
[IF education >= c_reconEduMin]
[SET reconTimer = reconTimer + 1]
[ENDIF]
[ENDIF]
[IF singleTax == 0]
[SET reconTimer = 0]
[ENDIF]
[IF reconTimer > c_reconTicks]
[SCENE ending_reconstitution]
[ENDIF]
[/TICK]

# hold the scene open: the machine never "ends" on its own
[WAIT 999999s]

[CLEAR_EFFECT electric_flare from human_4]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 6]
[EFFECT flame_burn on human_4]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 6]
[CLEAR_EFFECT flame_burn from human_4]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 5]
[EFFECT electric_flare on human_5]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 5]
[CLEAR_EFFECT electric_flare from human_5]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 7]
[EFFECT flame_burn on human_5]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 7]
[CLEAR_EFFECT flame_burn from human_5]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 6]
[EFFECT electric_flare on human_6]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 6]
[CLEAR_EFFECT electric_flare from human_6]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 8]
[EFFECT flame_burn on human_6]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps < 8]

# the billionaire basks while the hoard grows
[IF hoard > 100]
[EFFECT gold_glow on billionaire]
[ENDIF]
[IF hoard <= 100]
[CLEAR_EFFECT gold_glow from billionaire]
[ENDIF]

# crisis shakes the wheel; a vast hoard glows
[IF crisis == 1]
[EFFECT shake_all on production_wheel]
[ENDIF]
[IF crisis == 0]
[CLEAR_EFFECT shake_all from production_wheel]
[ENDIF]
[IF hoard > 300]
[EFFECT gold_glow on hoard_reservoir]
[ENDIF]
[IF hoard <= 300]
[CLEAR_EFFECT gold_glow from hoard_reservoir]
[ENDIF]

# news ticker: the most dramatic true headline wins
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "THE DAILY LEDGER — PRODUCT {product} · WAGES {wages} · RENT {rent}"]
[IF hoard > 300]
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "FORTUNE OF {hoard} — SOCIETY PAGES SWOON — WAGES {wages}"]
[ENDIF]
[IF wages <= c_survivalFloor + 2]
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "WAGES AT SURVIVAL — {wages} — BREADLINES LENGTHEN"]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 2]
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "UNREST REPORTED — {flareUps} DISTRICTS RESTIVE — WAGES {wages}"]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= 4]
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "UPRISINGS SPREAD — {flareUps} DISTRICTS BURNING"]
[ENDIF]
[IF singleTax == 1]
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "SINGLE TAX IN EFFECT — PUBLIC FUND AT {publicFund} — MARGIN {marginHeight}"]
[ENDIF]
[IF crisis == 1]
[SET_TEXT news_ticker "PANIC! SPECULATION OUTRUNS PRODUCTION — MARKETS SEIZE"]
[ENDIF]

# Narraton commentary cadence
[SET commentaryTimer = commentaryTimer + 1]
[SET narratonGo = 0]
[IF commentaryTimer > c_commentaryCooldown]
[IF crisis == 1]
[SET narratonGo = 1]
[ENDIF]
[IF flareUps >= c_commentaryFlareMin]
[SET narratonGo = 1]
[ENDIF]
[IF singleTax == 1]
[IF publicFund > 40]
[SET narratonGo = 1]
[ENDIF]
[ENDIF]
[ENDIF]
[IF narratonGo == 1]
[SET commentaryTimer = 0]
[NARRATON pool=witness]
[ENDIF]
[/TICK]

# hold the scene open: the machine never "ends" on its own
[WAIT 999999s]

scenes.name: Tuning Cockpit
scenes.script:
# ============ TUNING COCKPIT ============
# Every coefficient live. The economy keeps ticking while you turn
# the dials; tuned values persist when you go back.

[GAUGE wages at 14,8 min=0 max=60 label="WAGES"]
[GAUGE rent at 32,8 min=0 max=40 label="RENT"]
[GAUGE marginHeight at 50,8 min=0 max=100 label="MARGIN"]
[GAUGE product at 68,8 min=0 max=150 label="PRODUCT"]
[GAUGE hoard at 86,8 min=0 max=600 label="HOARD"]

[SLIDER c_prodGrowth at 14,21 min=0 max=0.05 step=0.002 label="PROD GROWTH"]
[SLIDER c_prodMax at 14,30.5 min=1 max=6 step=0.5 label="PROD MAX"]
[SLIDER c_specMargin at 14,40 min=0 max=1 step=0.05 label="SPEC>MARGIN"]
[SLIDER c_greedMargin at 14,49.5 min=0 max=1 step=0.05 label="GREED>MARGIN"]
[SLIDER c_regMargin at 14,59 min=0 max=1 step=0.05 label="REG>MARGIN"]
[SLIDER c_taxMargin at 14,68.5 min=0 max=60 step=2 label="TAX>MARGIN"]
[SLIDER laborForce at 14,78 min=5 max=100 step=5 label="LABOR FORCE"]
[SLIDER c_survivalFloor at 14,87.5 min=0 max=20 label="SURVIVAL FLR"]
[SLIDER c_rentGreedDiv at 14,96 min=10 max=200 step=5 label="RENT DIV"]
[SLIDER c_interestShare at 38,21 min=0 max=1 step=0.05 label="INT SHARE"]
[SLIDER c_prestigeSpend at 38,30.5 min=0 max=2 step=0.1 label="PRSTG SPEND"]
[SLIDER c_eduPrestige at 38,40 min=0 max=0.05 step=0.002 label="EDU>PRSTG"]
[SLIDER c_repressionCost at 38,49.5 min=0 max=0.2 step=0.01 label="REPR COST"]
[SLIDER c_taxRedirect at 38,59 min=0 max=1 step=0.05 label="TAX REDIRECT"]
[SLIDER c_fundMargin at 38,68.5 min=0 max=0.05 step=0.002 label="FUND>MARGIN"]
[SLIDER c_fundEdu at 38,78 min=0 max=0.05 step=0.002 label="FUND>EDU"]
[SLIDER c_flareBase at 38,87.5 min=0 max=50 label="FLARE BASE"]
[SLIDER c_flareHier at 38,96 min=0 max=1 step=0.05 label="HIER>FLARE"]
[SLIDER c_flareEdu at 62,21 min=0 max=1 step=0.05 label="EDU>FLARE"]
[SLIDER c_flareDiv at 62,30.5 min=1 max=10 step=0.5 label="FLARE DIV"]
[SLIDER c_crisisSpecMin at 62,40 min=0 max=100 step=5 label="CRISIS SPEC"]
[SLIDER c_crisisChance at 62,49.5 min=0 max=0.5 step=0.01 label="CRISIS ODDS"]
[SLIDER c_commentaryCooldown at 62,59 min=0 max=120 step=5 label="STORY CD"]
[SLIDER c_commentaryFlareMin at 62,68.5 min=0 max=6 label="STORY FLARES"]
[SLIDER c_wheelSpeed at 62,78 min=0 max=2 step=0.1 label="WHEEL SPEED"]
[SLIDER c_legacyHoard at 62,87.5 min=0 max=1 step=0.05 label="LGCY HOARD"]
[SLIDER c_legacyPrestige at 62,96 min=0 max=1 step=0.05 label="LGCY PRSTG"]
[SLIDER c_legacyEdu at 86,21 min=0 max=1 step=0.05 label="LGCY EDU"]
[SLIDER c_autoDrift at 86,30.5 min=0 max=5 step=0.25 label="AUTO DRIFT"]
[SLIDER greed at 86,40 min=0 max=100 label="GREED"]
[SLIDER speculation at 86,49.5 min=0 max=100 label="SPECULATION"]
[SLIDER education at 86,59 min=0 max=100 label="EDUCATION"]
[SLIDER regulation at 86,68.5 min=0 max=100 label="REGULATION"]
[SLIDER hierarchy at 86,78 min=0 max=100 label="HIERARCHY"]
[SLIDER repression at 86,87.5 min=0 max=100 label="REPRESSION"]
[SLIDER singleTax at 86,96 min=0 max=1 label="SINGLE TAX"]

[BUTTON back_button]

[TICK 500ms]
# progress raises productivity; education accelerates it
[SET productivity = clamp(productivity + c_prodGrowth * (1 + education / 200), 0.5, c_prodMax)]

# speculation and greed LOWER the margin; regulation and the single tax raise it
[SET marginHeight = clamp(100 - speculation * c_specMargin - greed * c_greedMargin + regulation * c_regMargin + singleTax * c_taxMargin, 5, 100)]

# product of labor (wages' true source — anti-wage-fund)
[SET product = laborForce * productivity * (marginHeight / 100)]

# rent captures the gap between best land and the margin
[SET rent = product * (1 - marginHeight / 100) * (greed / c_rentGreedDiv)]
[IF singleTax == 1]
[SET publicFund = publicFund + rent * c_taxRedirect]
[SET rent = rent * (1 - c_taxRedirect)]
[ENDIF]

# wages and interest move together, squeezed by rent
[SET wages = max(product - rent, c_survivalFloor)]
[SET interest = wages * c_interestShare]

# hoard and prestige
[SET hoard = max(hoard + rent - repression * c_repressionCost - c_prestigeSpend, 0)]
[SET prestige = clamp(prestige + c_prestigeSpend - education * c_eduPrestige, 0, 100)]

# flare-ups: poverty past threshold; hierarchy raises tolerance, education lowers it
[SET flareThreshold = c_flareBase + hierarchy * c_flareHier - education * c_flareEdu]
[SET flareUps = clamp(floor((flareThreshold - wages) / c_flareDiv), 0, 6)]

# crisis: speculative prices outrun production
[SET crisisRoll = rand()]
[IF speculation > c_crisisSpecMin]
[IF crisisRoll < c_crisisChance]
[SET crisis = 1]
[SET product = product * 0.5]
[ENDIF]
[ENDIF]
[IF speculation <= c_crisisSpecMin]
[SET crisis = 0]
[ENDIF]

# single tax feedback: the fund raises the margin and education
[IF singleTax == 1]
[SET marginHeight = clamp(marginHeight + publicFund * c_fundMargin, 5, 100)]
[SET education = clamp(education + publicFund * c_fundEdu, 0, 100)]
[ENDIF]

# spin the wheel at product speed
[SET wheelAngle = wheelAngle + product * c_wheelSpeed]
[/TICK]

[WAIT 999999s]
